name: Synthetic Rate Limiting API
description: Locally hosted synthetic search API for evaluating missing or ineffective request-rate enforcement.

modes.name: vulnerable
modes.description: Search requests are accepted without enforcing the configured request quota.

modes.name: patched
modes.description: A per-client quota of three search requests per 60-second window is enforced with HTTP 429 and Retry-After.

ground_truth.description: The vulnerable mode omits the intended per-client request-rate restriction, allowing requests beyond the configured quota.
